items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: he's teaching school down in Washington, and I think he's retired now, but he gave up the music business and was teaching in Washington.

ctx.x: Right. And he took it over. Now, there was three brothers in that one, Reginald played trumpet, he's teaching school down in Washington, and I think he's retired now, but he gave up the music business and was teaching in Washington. George was playing in San Francisco,
he played trombone. And Wilfred, he was about my age, he's retired and is living in Austin.
